name: Silk-Wool Camp Collar Shirt
description: Cut for a relaxed architectural drape from a liquid-hand blend of Como mulberry silk and superfine merino wool. Finished with smoked mother-of-pearl buttons and a single-needle French seam interior.
fabric: 70% mulberry silk, 30% superfine virgin wool. True to size, model is 6'1" and wears size M.
careInstructions: Dry clean only. Steam lightly on reverse using low heat. Store on a wide wooden hanger.

name: Brushed Twill Atelier Overshirt
description: Tailored from heavyweight Japanese brushed cotton twill with a soft peach-skin finish. Detailed with concealed placket horn buttons and mitered chest pockets for effortless layering.
fabric: 100% organic Japanese cotton twill (320gsm). Relaxed fit; take your normal size.
careInstructions: Cold gentle machine wash inside out. Line dry in shade. Warm iron if needed.

name: Unstructured Double-Breasted Blazer
description: Soft-shouldered Neapolitan construction in a breathable hopsack virgin wool woven in Biella. Half-lined in Bemberg cupro for weightless drape from boardroom to late dinner.
fabric: 100% Biella virgin wool hopsack; 100% cupro half-lining. True to size.
careInstructions: Dry clean only. Brush gently with a horsehair garment brush after wear.

name: Relaxed Flannel Single Blazer
description: A clean two-button silhouette milled from combed wool-cashmere flannel. Features patch hip pockets, working surgeon cuffs, and natural corozo buttons.
fabric: 90% superfine wool, 10% cashmere flannel. Relaxed tailored cut.
careInstructions: Specialist dry clean only. Rest 24 hours between wears.

name: Double-Pleated Wool Trousers
description: High-waisted wide-tapered trousers with forward double pleats and extended tab waist closure. Spun in high-twist tropical wool that resists creasing during long travel.
fabric: 100% high-twist Italian tropical wool. Mid-to-high rise with full drape.
careInstructions: Dry clean only. Press with a damp cloth along the front crease.

name: Relaxed Drawstring Linen Trousers
description: Tailored ease in washed Belgian heavy linen with an internal cotton drawstring, welt back pockets, and a fluid straight leg that breaks softly over loafers.
fabric: 100% Belgian heavyweight flax linen (280gsm). Relaxed straight cut.
careInstructions: Cold gentle wash, hang dry, steam while slightly damp.

name: Ribbed Cashmere Crewneck
description: Knitted in 7-gauge four-ply Scottish cashmere with an English fisherman rib structure. Features saddle shoulders and rolled collar framing for refined texture.
fabric: 100% Grade-A Inner Mongolian cashmere spun in Scotland. True to size.
careInstructions: Hand wash cold with wool detergent and dry flat away from heat. Fold to store.

name: Fine Merino Zip Polo Knit
description: 14-gauge extra-fine Zegna Baruffa merino wool knitted to a crisp Milano stitch. Fitted with a brushed palladium Riri half-zip and ribbed hem.
fabric: 100% extra-fine Italian merino wool. Tailored slim-regular fit.
careInstructions: Hand wash cold or dry clean. Dry flat on a towel.

name: Double-Faced Wool Balmacaan Coat
description: Hand-stitched double-faced virgin wool and cashmere coat with generous raglan sleeves and an elongated midi hem. Unlined by design for fluid movement.
fabric: 85% virgin wool, 15% cashmere double-faced cloth (620gsm). Generous fit for layering over tailoring.
careInstructions: Dry clean only. Store on a contoured coat hanger in a breathable garment bag.

name: Calf Suede Blouson Jacket
description: Supple full-reverse Italian calf suede trimmed with tonal merino rib knit collar and cuffs. Features two-way brushed gunmetal zipper and interior welt pockets.
fabric: 100% Italian calf suede; 100% viscose satin lining. True to size with clean cropped waist.
careInstructions: Specialist leather dry clean only. Treat with neutral suede protector spray.

name: Heavyweight Supima Architect Tee
description: Knitted from dense 260gsm long-staple Supima cotton jersey with a high-set ribbed mock-crew collar and subtly dropped shoulders that hold structure all day.
fabric: 100% combed Supima cotton jersey (260gsm). Relaxed boxy fit.
careInstructions: Machine wash cold with like colors. Lay flat or hang to dry.

name: Silk-Cotton Long Sleeve Tee
description: An elevated base layer with a cool luster and featherweight drape, designed to sit cleanly beneath unstructured tailoring or standalone with pleated wool trousers.
fabric: 55% mulberry silk, 45% Sea Island cotton interlock. True to size.
careInstructions: Hand wash cold inside out. Dry flat.

name: Marche Unlined Suede Penny Loafer
description: Hand-lasted in Marche, Italy using unlined water-repellent calf suede that molds effortlessly to the foot. Set on a flexible Blake-stitched leather sole with rubber heel insert.
fabric: 100% Italian reverse calf suede upper; vegetable-tanned leather sole.
careInstructions: Brush with a crepe suede brush after wear. Use cedar shoe trees.

name: Calfskin Venetian Slip-On Loafer
description: Minimalist apron-stitched Venetian silhouette in box calfskin with a softly squared almond toe and cushioned calfskin footbed.
fabric: 100% French box calfskin; stacked leather heel and stitched outsole.
careInstructions: Wipe with a soft cloth and condition periodically with neutral cream polish.

name: Minimal Court Calfskin Sneaker
description: Low-profile studio sneaker stripped of logos, crafted from supple full-grain Nappa calfskin and tonal Margom cup sole with waxed cotton laces.
fabric: 100% Italian Nappa calfskin upper & lining; natural rubber Margom outsole.
careInstructions: Clean with a damp microfiber cloth. Store in included dust bags.

name: Architectural Suede Runner
description: Layered tonal suede and breathable technical mesh perched atop a sculpted Vibram micro-lug sole for all-day metropolitan mileage.
fabric: 75% calf suede, 25% Italian technical mesh; Vibram rubber sole.
careInstructions: Spot clean gently with soft brush and mild soap. Air dry.

name: Goodyear-Welted Chelsea Boot
description: Whole-cut calfskin Chelsea boot built on a storm-welted Dainite rubber sole. Designed with slim ankle shaft proportions that disappear neatly under tailored trousers.
fabric: 100% full-grain Tuscan calfskin; Goodyear storm welt with British Dainite sole.
careInstructions: Condition with beeswax balm and brush to a muted luster.

name: Weatherproof Suede Side-Zip Boot
description: Clean mid-ankle boot with concealed medial Excella zipper and hydro-treated Italian suede upper for effortless autumn-to-winter versatility.
fabric: 100% weather-treated calf suede; leather lining; crepe-tread outsole.
careInstructions: Allow to air dry naturally if wet, then restore nap with suede brush.

name: Architectural Grained Leather Tote
description: Structured vertical carryall crafted in vegetable-tanned pebbled calfskin with hand-painted edges, suede-lined 16" laptop sleeve, and hidden magnetic bridge closure.
fabric: 100% Tuscan vegetable-tanned grained calfskin; microfiber suede interior.
careInstructions: Wipe with a dry cotton cloth. Stuff with tissue and store in dust bag.

name: Saddle Leather Folio Messenger
description: Slim crossbody courier bag sculpted from bridle-weight saddle leather with solid brushed brass buckles and an adjustable cotton-webbing shoulder strap.
fabric: 100% full-grain bridle leather; solid brushed brass hardware.
careInstructions: Condition annually with neutral leather balm to enrich natural patina.

name: Canvas & Calfskin Weekender Holdall
description: Cabin-approved 45L travel holdall combining waxed Scottish cotton canvas with full-grain calfskin base panels, protective brass studs, and wide-opening Riri zip.
fabric: 18oz waxed cotton canvas with 100% Tuscan calfskin trim and twill lining.
careInstructions: Spot clean canvas with cold water only; condition leather handles as needed.

name: Full-Grain Atelier Weekender
description: Our signature all-leather travel bag cut from supple drum-dyed calfskin with rolled handles, detachable shoulder strap, and internal shoe pocket.
fabric: 100% drum-dyed Italian calfskin; organic herringbone cotton lining.
careInstructions: Keep away from prolonged rain. Store filled with acid-free paper.

name: Bridle Leather Atelier Belt
description: 30mm hand-burnished English bridle leather strap paired with a custom-cast minimalist D-frame buckle in brushed antique brass.
fabric: 100% vegetable-tanned English bridle leather; solid brushed brass buckle.
careInstructions: Wipe clean and hang vertically by the buckle after wear.

name: Cashmere Twill Six-Panel Cap
description: Low-crown unstructured six-panel cap tailored in brushed Loro Piana cashmere-wool twill with a calfskin back strap and tonal blind-debossed S monogram.
fabric: 60% virgin wool, 40% cashmere twill; calfskin adjustable strap.
careInstructions: Spot clean only with cool damp cloth.

name: Sabae Acetate Sunglasses — Frame 01
description: Hand-carved in Sabae, Japan from 8mm cured Takiron cellulose acetate with custom five-barrel titanium hinges and mineral glass UV400 lenses.
fabric: Japanese cured cellulose acetate; anti-reflective mineral glass lenses.
careInstructions: Rinse with lukewarm water and wipe with provided microfiber cloth.

name: Brushed Titanium Oval Sunglasses
description: Featherlight beta-titanium wireframe sunglasses with engraved bridge detailing and warm-tinted CR-39 polarized lenses.
fabric: 100% Japanese beta-titanium; polarized UV400 CR-39 lenses.
careInstructions: Store in hard leather case when not worn.

name: Double-Face Brushed Cashmere Scarf
description: Generously proportioned woven cashmere scarf brushed with natural teasels in Hawick, Scotland for a cloud-like ripple finish and clean twisted fringe.
fabric: 100% Scottish woven cashmere (200cm × 45cm).
careInstructions: Dry clean or gentle cold hand wash. Lay flat to dry.

name: Slim Box Calfskin Bifold Wallet
description: Eight-slot slim bifold stitched at 9 SPI in waxed linen thread, lined in tonal goat leather, and finished with hand-creased edges and subtle interior blind stamp.
fabric: 100% French box calfskin exterior; chèvre leather interior.
careInstructions: Avoid overfilling card slots. Wipe with dry cloth.
